subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Mainul returned to his village after completing his higher education and started (a) ------- farming. His two brothers, who are also graduates, chose to stay in the (b) ------- too. One of them is a science teacher, and the other plans to start a (c) ------- to serve the local area. They all believe that education should not only prepare one to become an (d) -------, but also teach responsibility towards their birthplace. Mr. Islam said he feels happy working on his own farm, being with family and old friends, and sleeping in his own (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) advanced; (b) village; (c) NGO; (d) officer; (e) home;
